messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] cannot reproduce example BYM
parts:
On Tue, 2016-06-28 at 06:20 -0700, mh wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I cannot run some old R-INLA code for a BYM model anymore. I receive
> several warings when I compute zeta=exp(csi) where csi=upsilon + nu
>
> "In dx * xx$y[1:n] :
>   longer object length is not a multiple of shorter object length"

this problem is fixed in the most recent version, please upgrade by

inla.update(testing=T)



> It also emerges when I run the code by Blangiardo et al (2012,
> http://www.r-inla.org/examples/case-studies/blangiardo-et-al-2012):
>
> formula <- y ~ 1 + f(ID, model="bym", graph=LDN.adj)
> mod <- inla(formula,family="poisson",data=data,E=E)
> #We calculate zeta=exp(csi) where csi=upsilon + nu
> m <- mod$marginals.random$ID[1:Nareas]
> zeta <- lapply(m,function(x)inla.emarginal(exp,x)) # WARNINGS 
>
> I am using INLA_0.0-1462127027
>
> Thanks,
> Mrco
